description: This file defines the ClientCredentials class, representing a client credentials grant in OAuth2, extending an abstract grant class, including methods to get the grant name and required request parameters.

classes.name: League\uOAuth2\uClient\uGrant\uClientCredentials
classes.description: Represents a client credentials grant in OAuth2, providing methods for retrieving grant name and required parameters, extending the AbstractGrant class.

methods.name: getName
methods.description: Returns the name of the grant, 'client_credentials'.

methods.name: getRequiredRequestParameters
methods.description: Returns an empty array, indicating no additional request parameters are required for this grant.
